description: This file defines a wizard for changing production quantity in an Odoo (OpenERP) manufacturing module, including form layout, data retrieval, validation, and update logic.

classes.name: change_production_qty
classes.description: Wizard interface class for changing production quantity with defined states and actions.

methods.name: _get_qty
methods.description: Retrieves current product quantity for the production order and sets it as default in the form.

methods.name: _get_states
methods.description: Determines the next state based on the production order's current state, raising warnings if necessary.

methods.name: _change_prod_qty
methods.description: Updates the production order's product quantity and related stock moves, recalculating BOM components.
